reviews.snippet:
The food Veg and Non Veg was good.
The Steward Mr. Dinesh was very humble and provided excellent service.
The ambience was also good.
Only observation was the poor maintenance of hand wash area and the washroom. If a little bit of extra care on the higiene will make the place worth for families to spend some good time 💕

reviews.snippet:
Ambience is beautiful, service is excellent, food is very good...
Special thanks and wonderful service by Aman, Kripan and Rohit... A place that can be visited family and friends, they understood what customers service means for us, they cared for us and this means I will keep coming with my corporate friends and family. This place should feel proud of having such people to serve n take care of people so that they keep coming each time

We all liked the washroom hygeine and this is kudos to Management

reviews.snippet: A decent dining place . Good ambiance . Nice food . Clean washroom . But do check your bill especially when in big groups and when you have ordered varieties . You might end up paying for more dishes than you have ordered .
